name: Ten Commendation Signets
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText:
Excellent! It is no small sacrifice that you've made to earn these signets, and you will be acknowledged for your service appropriately. It's adventurers like you, adventurer, that truly make a difference.

Let me know if you have additional signets to hand in; I'll gladly help you out with whatever ones you need exchanged.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I accept commendation signets from adventurers who have received them in the line of duty. For each set of ten that you hand to me, I'll make sure that you receive a significant acknowledgement of your deeds with Stormwind. I also accept single tokens, but at a much reduced rate of recognition. We are much more interested in greater feats of duty, though no feat will be ignored.

With that said, I'll gladly take your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
